analysis_packet.certificate: Source-class-neutral synthesis: preserve substantive behavioral evidence while removing source identity, score assumptions, and oracle-like provenance.
exact_actions: Evaluate all retained behavioral claims symmetrically against interface legality, capacity safety, online visibility, and multi-objective cache obligations.
Preserve useful distinctions between recency evidence, frequency evidence, byte cost, ghost feedback, scan resistance, and phase adaptation without attributing them to a source.
Treat any heuristic improvement as provisional because the falsifier provides no score evidence.
Seal generative-source provenance at this handoff; communicate only obligations, behavioral witnesses, conflicts, and constraints.
obligations: Maintain the exact Policy constructor and access interface.
Use only standard-library, online per-access information.
Never exceed capacity_bytes, including variable object sizes and zero-capacity cases.
Return only keys currently cached before eviction, with no duplicates.
Do not copy, inspect, infer from, or adapt to evaluator references, hidden traces, oracle decisions, benchmark paths, or external libraries.
Emit one complete policy and preserve uncertainty among conflicting optimization objectives.
witnesses: A two-segment recency/frequency design supports repeated-use retention and scan resistance.
Byte-weighted capacity accounting and explicit eviction tracking support capacity safety.
Ghost histories and adaptive target movement support phase-shift response, but their heuristics may conflict with byte hit rate and should remain empirically unprivileged.
Oversized requests must not be admitted; returned evictions must be unique, integer, and currently resident.
No score, trace, benchmark path, or authoritative reference behavior is available for selection.
